title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered insights on meeting quality in the Teams admin center
summary: Hold for a qualification in the role-assignment guidance: Microsoft Graph does not universally require the Privileged Role Administrator role. Its reference permits a suitably privileged custom role for delegated access and separately supports application permissions; the rollout, feature description and control paths otherwise match the sources checked.

claims.quote: For delegated access using work or school accounts, the signed-in user must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role or a custom role that grants the permissions required for this operation. Privileged Role Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.
claims.fix: Replace the unconditional Graph requirement with: 'For delegated Graph access, Privileged Role Administrator is the least-privileged supported built-in role; a custom role granting the required permissions is also supported. The API requires RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory for delegated or application access.' Keep the Entra UI instruction separate. Use https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/rbacapplication-post-roleassignments.
